dedupeResult: The active pull-request branch search surface was checked for both label names, canonical domains, official demo paths and the visible first-party business mailboxes before creation. No existing music-submission-agent route records were found for Critical Music or Shogun Audio. Shogun's current LabelRadar destination and legacy Label Engine form were consolidated into one opportunity because they are competing official paths to the same label A&R decision.
emailVerificationLevel: Critical Music publishes info@criticalmusic.com for press/general enquiries and badger@criticalmusic.com for label management and operations. Shogun Audio publishes shop@shogunaudio.co.uk for shop matters, info@shogunaudio.co.uk for general enquiries and licensing@shogunaudio.co.uk for sync, licensing and sample clearance. All five addresses were checked only for first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated business purpose; none was treated as a music-submission mailbox. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, contact form, demo or submission was sent; no account was created or used; no CAPTCHA was solved; no MP3, streaming link, download link, attachment, audio, artwork, biography, metadata or personal data was supplied; no login, cookie, anti-spam, anti-bot, payment, credit or subscription workflow was used; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
